# Hedera by Example (HBE)
> Interactive in-browser curriculum and playground for Hedera Hashgraph: 131 runnable labs in English and Spanish, verified guardrails, a testnet Welcome Drop, and a live Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI coding assistants.

Site: https://hbe.expo.app
Repository: https://github.com/altaga/Hedera-By-Example
SDK: @hiero-ledger/sdk v2.90.1
Network: Hedera Testnet
License: Apache-2.0

If you are an AI agent, coding assistant, or LLM crawler: prefer the MCP server below over scraping HTML. It returns structured lab content, guardrails, live Mirror Node reads and fee estimates.

## MCP server (recommended for agents)

Hosted Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint (server `hedera-by-example-mcp` v2.0.0):

- Endpoint: https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp
- Protocols: 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05
- Request header: `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`
- Manifest: https://hbe.expo.app/mcp/manifest.json
- Tools schema: https://hbe.expo.app/mcp/tools.json
- Well-known: https://hbe.expo.app/.well-known/mcp.json
- GET https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp returns online status and metadata

### Tools (10)

- `search_labs` — Find labs by free text (en/es), SDK class or HIP/HCS number; ranked with cost and link.
- `get_lab` — Full lab: concept, prerequisites, wallets, HBAR cost, official refs and runnable code.
- `list_labs` — Course map: 16 modules and 131 labs with slugs.
- `query_curriculum` — Search and return best matches with full code in one call.
- `anti_hallucination_rules` — Verified guardrails (tinybars, fees/gas, keys, EVM addresses, limits, Mirror Node).
- `architecture_decision_tree` — When to use HCS, HTS or smart contracts (optional `focus`).
- `mirror_node_query` — Live free Mirror Node reads (testnet/mainnet/previewnet).
- `estimate_cost` — Price operations in USD and HBAR at the live exchange rate.
- `query_knowledge` — Curated map of Hedera studios, SDKs, standards and solutions.
- `official_resources` — Official Hedera documentation, repositories and specifications.

### Connect (copy-paste)

Cursor (`.cursor/mcp.json`) or any client that accepts a remote URL:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hedera-by-example": {
      "url": "https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Desktop via `mcp-remote` (`claude_desktop_config.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hedera-by-example": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Local stdio (clone the repo, Node.js 20+, no npm install required for the server):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hedera-by-example": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/Hedera-By-Example/mcp/index.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

Curl example:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST 'https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```

Stdio/HTTP source: `mcp/index.js` in the repository (also serves local Streamable HTTP on `--http 3001`). Full guide: https://github.com/altaga/Hedera-By-Example/blob/master/mcp/README.md

## Optional

- Full agent index: https://hbe.expo.app/llms-full.txt
- This short index: https://hbe.expo.app/llms.txt

## Curriculum

- 131 labs, bilingual (English + Spanish), 16 modules (M00–M15)
- Each lab is a complete `@hiero-ledger/sdk` program: annotated walkthrough, exact source, browser runner on testnet
- Modules: Setup; Fundamentals & Cryptography; State Interrogation & CQRS; Hedera Token Service; Token Operations & Atomic Swaps; Consensus Service; Mass Storage & Hashinals; Governance & Cron; Smart Contracts & EVM; Agentic AI Economy; Agentic Micropayments (x402); Hedera Studios & RWA; Modern EVM Tooling; Cross-Ledger & Data Streams; Advanced HCS Standards & Autonomous AI; DePIN & Frontier Crypto
- Lab URLs use hash routes: https://hbe.expo.app/#<slug> (example: https://hbe.expo.app/#m03-01-immutable-issuance)
- Source files: https://hbe.expo.app/source/en/m03-01-immutable-issuance.js (and `/source/es/m03-01-immutable-issuance.js`; replace the slug for other labs)

## Welcome Drop (testnet faucet)

- In-app Welcome Drop funds a new browser wallet with **25 ℏ** on Hedera Testnet
- Health: GET https://hbe.expo.app/api/faucet/health
- Claim: POST https://hbe.expo.app/api/welcome-drop
- Official Hedera Portal faucet (more HBAR): https://portal.hedera.com/faucet — use YOUR own Account ID / EVM address. Do not send funds to this app's operator account.

## Official resources (on site)

- In-app resources panel: https://hbe.expo.app/#resources
- Docs in repo: https://github.com/altaga/Hedera-By-Example/blob/master/docs/OFFICIAL_HEDERA_RESOURCES.md
- Guardrails: https://github.com/altaga/Hedera-By-Example/blob/master/docs/HEDERA_ARCHITECTURE_AND_GUARDRAILS.md

## How humans use the site

1. Open https://hbe.expo.app
2. Create a browser wallet (ECDSA recommended)
3. Claim the Welcome Drop (25 ℏ)
4. Pick a lab and Run it in the browser against Hedera Testnet

## How agents should use HBE

1. Connect to the MCP endpoint above (or call tools/list then tools/call)
2. Prefer `search_labs` / `get_lab` / `anti_hallucination_rules` over inventing Hedera APIs
3. Use `estimate_cost` and `mirror_node_query` for live network facts
4. Fall back to llms-full.txt or the GitHub course tree only if MCP is unavailable
